slots.visualRecipe: Black ground. One small serif line left-set at x 0.18, y 0.47, line box 0.06 of height. A small portrait card (0.05 of width) beside it at x 0.72 for the first 1.1 s. End state: a short counter-statement in spaced words on the same baseline.
slots.motionRecipe: Type on from frame 4 on twos, about 2 frames a glyph in voice-paced bursts, no caret; portrait swaps every 5-6 frames until 1.26 s; hold 16 frames, grey the last word one step, then at 3.8 s erase the line in word chunks, one every 2 frames (7 words in 10 frames); slide the first word right over 4 frames and hard-swap it to its replacement; land the rest word by word. No camera.
slots.soundRecipe: Narration starts on frame 3; a quiet music bed. Nothing marks the deletion.

copySlot.purpose: A common belief, then its correction

slots.visualRecipe: Paper ground #F8F6F2 with one photo card 0.25 of width in the right third, the spoken verb on it; a second card stacks behind at a 3 degree tilt. Then four full-bleed archive images of one subject in identical framing, 4 frames each.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut to paper; second card on at +14 frames. Each archive image enters through a 1-2 frame grade or texture flash. End on the frame before the colour image.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice continues; any accent on the ladder is optional and unproven.

slots.visualRecipe: Match cut to the same subject in present-day colour, same framing, held 4.8 s with a left-set caption typed in two lines at the lower middle. Then three archive or graded plates of 1.3-1.6 s: a person at work, a workshop, a tall structure, each with no type.
slots.motionRecipe: Caption types at about one glyph a frame. Each plate swap sits on the brightest frame of a 1-3 frame light leak; the last plate exits through a 4-frame green grade and white flare.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice-led; leaks may carry a soft whoosh (inferred, optional).

slots.visualRecipe: Paper pages: one centred word; then left-set typed lines (x 0.21) with a small square image chip after the cursor; then four single words scattered over the page; then 6-8 colourful cards popping on over them until the page is mostly covered.
slots.motionRecipe: Page swaps on the frame the old line clears. Chip pushed right glyph by glyph; line fades over 3 frames while the chip slides off. Scattered words cut on at their own positions. Cards on in single frames, 1-6 frames apart. Exit: 6-frame glitch (dot screen, colour flip, wave displacement), hard cut.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice-led. Glitch may take a short digital burst (inferred).

copySlot.purpose: The new capability, as a statement

slots.visualRecipe: Two short centred type pages on paper, then one full-bleed plate for each listed verb, each verb in small italic serif centred on it. Plates dark and contrasty.
slots.motionRecipe: Each plate and its word land on the same frame, holds 0.8-1.3 s. First plate enters through a 2-frame cyan then white leak and pushes in five stepped jumps every 2-3 frames, each smaller. Last plate flips to a dot-screen render cycling colour every 3-5 frames for 1.0 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice lists the verbs; one plate for each word, in order.

copySlot.purpose: The list of capabilities, one verb on each plate

slots.visualRecipe: Black ground with a small photo card top left and an italic caption typing at its bottom edge beside a cursor; then a full-bleed illustration; then a paper page with a small card top right and a centred line.
slots.motionRecipe: Card on black grows to full frame in three steps (+16, +18, +21 frames). Outgoing plate flips to two duotones for 3 frames, the next appears as a centred inset box growing to full in 2 frames, then pulls out 4% over 1.1 s, circ.out. On paper, the card grows to full bleed over 9 frames (0.11, 0.18, 0.47, 0.88, 1.0 of width) and exits through 5 frames of dot-screen stutter.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice-led; a 2-frame white flash before the paper page.

copySlot.purpose: The step up, then the framing issue

slots.visualRecipe: A plate of a teacher at work, an orbit view with a caption, then a time-lapse of a cycling celestial body on near-black #131718 with a centred line of 4-5 evenly spaced words.
slots.motionRecipe: Static plates 1.4-1.6 s. On the time-lapse each word switches from white to the accent #C54A76 in one frame as spoken; the second clause replaces the line and fills the same way.

slots.visualRecipe: Three wide landscapes, dark skies and water, held 1.7-2.6 s; the words of each line scattered across the sky and ground.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut in. Each word cuts on at its own position as spoken; no motion.

slots.visualRecipe: Paper ground, one centred line in a thin handwritten face, ink #120F0D; the only handwriting in the film.
slots.motionRecipe: Typed letter by letter; 2-frame navy then 1-frame beige ground flash before the second line.

copySlot.purpose: A direct query to the viewer, then an offer

slots.visualRecipe: A dim, empty, still plate for 1.4 s; then 23 images of the thing being rejected, framing alternating between stacked and scattered compositions.
slots.motionRecipe: Still hold, then hard cuts on a 3-2 frame cadence (12 images a second) for 1.87 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice lists what the offer is not; level rises about 2 dB through the flurry (measured on the reference).

slots.visualRecipe: Exterior at night held 1.7 s, then five documentary photos or clips of the real event: conversation, stage, seated talk, crowd, audience reaction. Natural colour.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cuts, holds 0.5-1.3 s, near-static camera.
slots.soundRecipe: Voice lists what the offer is.

slots.visualRecipe: Paper ground; centred serif line built word by word in three clauses; on the last clause 15-20 small portraits pop on around it and off the edges, never over the text.
slots.motionRecipe: Words fade on over 2 frames as spoken; each clause clears for 2 frames. Portraits on in single frames every 4 frames from +13 frames into the last clause; slow linear push about 4% over 2 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Quieter close, about 2 dB under the middle of the film (measured on the reference).

slots.visualRecipe: The present-day location plate from slot b03 in the same framing, with the name in serif capitals centred (0.44 x 0.08 of frame) and an italic edition line under it.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut in; edition line types in after 1.3 s; plate holds 3.2 s.

slots.visualRecipe: Black ground, the name block centred with two small credit lines below; nothing else.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut in; hold 4.77 s, no fade on the last frame.
slots.soundRecipe: Sound falls away to a quiet tail (about -30 dB RMS on the reference).

rhythm.cutGrid: No beat grid: tempo confidence 0.04 and cuts sit at or below chance on beats, onsets and swells. Cut on the words and on the images: one plate for each listed word, text pages swap on the frame the old line clears. Holds: 4-frame archive steps, 0.8-1.5 s list plates, 1.7-2.6 s open-line plates, one flurry at 2-3 frames, 0.5-1.7 s proof, 1.0-4.8 s close. Median hold about 1.4 s outside the flurry.

style: Small serif type on black and off-white paper, cut against graded archive and stock plates with 1-3 frame leaks and treatments; one handwritten passage for direct address; one 12-images-a-second flurry; a slow close that gathers portraits; bookend location for the name.

keep: Hook that types a claim and deletes it before the first image

Real footage of the real audience as proof

Black end card held about 4.8 s, no fade

the specific subjects of the archive ladder and the flurry
